messages.text:
What it is: Enh: Operator can ask the human a clarifying question in the front-desk SUP thread and hold a runtime-owned awaiting-answer state (bounded: escalate once then drop; never blocks emergencies; never guesses)
What it solves: The Operator is a DISPOSABLE per-event LLM (operator.prompt): it acts then exits and can
NEVER wait — the always-alive `operator_runtime.bb` owns all cross-run state/waiting. So
"ask + await" splits: the LLM ASKS (one run), the RUNTIME holds the awaiting state and
pairs the later answer + times out.
How it works: Asking posts the question into the front-desk SUP thread and records a runtime-owned awaiting-answer state (so it is not re-asked while pending)
